Still stuck after waiting. Let me try interacting with the notice board one more way — maybe pressing KeyE while facing up repeatedly, or maybe the notice board is read by pressing KeyE and it's actually at (2,6) not (2,7). Let me re-examine: world_find said "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks [0 tiles]" — 0 tiles away, meaning it's on my tile.

Let me try pressing KeyE while facing up toward (2,6) — done, nothing. 

I wonder if the issue is that the notice board occupies my tile and the game won't let me leave because it thinks I'm inside a solid. Perhaps there's a "read" action that removes it. Let me try pressing KeyE many times while facing each direction in a loop, in case one triggers reading the board on my tile.
